edits.old: Then the operation returns 503 with the platform problem body and nothing is written
edits.new:
Then the operation returns 503 with the platform problem body and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC10 Business rules BR1 to BR10 hold in the build (section 8)
    Given the build scan of the service and the rwb-decision rule-set fake
    When the boundary and rule checks run
    Then no balance is copied or stored, no table of another service or case table is written and no value a business person may change is written in code

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers 403 and 404 of the provided operation
    Given the rwb-access authorise fake refuses right U in Treatment and offer for a role, and a caseId that names no case in the scope
    When the RouteRequest is sent to POST /cases/{caseId}/route
    Then the operation returns 403 for the role without the right and 404 for the caseId that names no case, and no account is read

  Scenario: AC12 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a RouteRequest whose Idempotency-Key is already recorded in the idempotency row of the decision record
    When the same RouteRequest is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then no second decision record is written and the answer of the first call is returned

  Scenario: AC13 Activity retried after a timeout writes once
    Given the calculatePayoffAndRange activity times out after the rwb-source-data read has gone unanswered
    When the workflow retries the activity with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the decision record is written once and the answer is returned once

  Scenario: AC14 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given the rwb-decision rule-set fake fails the call
    When the case owner prepares the route decision
    Then the operation returns 503 with the platform problem body and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC15 Status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the calculation state is absent
    When a status change is requested that the calculation model does not allow
    Then the change is refused and nothing is written
